title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Translucent Drafting Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Translucent Drafting Board
options.thesis: A clear, accessible overlay that clarifies complex documents with precision grids.
options.viewport: A clean pane over an obscured background, putting focus strictly on the task.
options.risk: Can feel too clinical if spacing is tight.

raised.raise: Bold, literal quoted labeling for maximum clarity without ambiguity.
Soft, elegant light-blue pastel edges to warm the clinical tone.

options.label: The Optometrist Exam
options.thesis: Stark contrast and bold typography for absolute legibility.
options.viewport: Massive typography for key actions scaling down to reading sizes.
options.risk: Fails the 'friendly' prompt by leaning heavily into extreme utility.

options.label: Industrial Streetwear
options.case: Loses on audience identification (too edgy) but has strong literal clarity.

options.label: Cloud Edge Diffraction
options.case: Loses on clarity (too soft and low-contrast) but has elegant appeal.
options.kept: Soft pastel borders and warm tones.
